description: Compound endpoint: one image in, full creative brief out. Extracts dominant colours, matches them to the Colour Memory archive with coherent cultural naming, understands the scene, identifies the style period, suggests product directions by category (textiles, interiors, fashion), generates an image generation prompt, and returns a swatch URL. One call covers what palette_extract + palette_analyse + agent_brief do separately. style_context gives coherent archive matching, e.g. 'English cottage garden', 'Victorian', 'MarsColour'. The result already carries the rendered palette and its PNG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS downloads, ready to show the customer. The archive anchors a colour was derived from are evidence, not the recommended colours. A final palette chosen from this evidence is registered with palette_finalize, called once with those exact colours, so the customer can see and download what was actually recommended.

grey_card_hex.description: Hex value from a grey/white card for white balance correction

k.description: Number of colours to extract (3-12, default 6)

model.description: Image model: midjourney | flux | dalle | stable_diffusion (default midjourney)

style_context.description: Plain English style e.g. 'English cottage garden', 'Victorian', 'Japanese', 'MarsColour'. Restricts archive matching to coherent cultural set.

name: image_brief
title: Generate Creative Brief from Image
